analyst_view.overall: Early view: Telstar host Groningen on a Friday night. The brief lists Etienne Vaessen and Hans Hateboer as missing, but both bans were one match and will have been served in the northern derby on 21 November, so both should be available. Telstar are in the play-off place but beat Utrecht 4-2 and drew 2-2 at Fortuna, and one report says fans turned on coach Henk Brugge after the cup exit.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals. Telstar have scored six in two league games and Groningen's last two finished 2-3 and 3-4, so goals are likely; with Vaessen back I do not push it above the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. Telstar lean on set pieces and Groningen press high, but neither fact changes how many corners the game should produce.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.1 cards. I lean higher: Groningen finished their AZ game with nine men and their own director says Vaessen's temper hurts the team, and Telstar are fighting to stay up.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.8 shots. Both sides have been creating chances lately, which fits the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.4 shots on target. I lean a little lower: Telstar's recent goals came largely from set pieces rather than open-play shooting, and 6.3 on target for Groningen away looks high.
